turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no MQL metric; the closest is Leads (CRM leads created, on the day they were created), and social-channel leads for 1 to 30 September 2026 came to 40 leads. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
